A [[human]] individual served the [[First Order]] as a '''stormtrooper''' aboard the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]''. In [[34 ABY]], the [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] searched a captured [[Unidentified AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|shuttle]] for the allies of the [[Desertion|defecting]] [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|First Order pilot]] [[Tamara Ryvora]]. The [[trooper]] did not find her conspirators, but learned that the [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|shuttle]] was set to [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruct]]. They fled the [[Shuttle|ship]] and warned [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] and [[Agent]] [[Tierny]], but were knocked down when the [[Starship|vessel]] exploded.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Search the shuttle.|Pyre ordering the trooper|audio=PyreSearch-TheEscape.flac|<ref name="Escape" />}}
A [[human]]<ref name="Human" /> individual served the [[First Order]] as a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]].<ref name="Escape" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">{{ResistanceDate|2|19}}</ref> when a [[Unidentified AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|shuttle]] was captured in the [[hangar]] of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Escape" /> ''[[Thunderer]]'',<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> the [[trooper]] was one of several stormtroopers who ran to the [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport|shuttle]] and aimed [[F-11D blaster rifle]]s at two [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|First Order pilots]]—[[Tamara Ryvora]], who was [[Desertion|defecting]], and [[Jace Rucklin|DT-798]], who remained loyal to the First Order—as they both exited with their [[Limb|hands]] raised. After [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] accused Ryvora of [[treason]] and demanded to know where the rest of her conspirators were, she claimed there was no one else, but DT-798 revealed there were others inside the [[shuttle]].<ref name="Escape" />

[[File:ThundererStormtrooperFleeing-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|250px|The stormtrooper (center right) attempted to flee from the exploding shuttle.]]
At Pyre's command, the individual and another stormtrooper ran up the shuttle's [[entry ramp]], knocking into Ryvora and DT-798 as they did. Aboard the [[Starship|ship]], the troopers were unable to find Ryvora's allies—[[Kazuda Xiono]], [[Jarek Yeager]], and [[CB-23]]—who had already [[Unidentified maneuver (Jarek Yeager)|sneaked]] out of it, but learned that the vessel had been set to [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruct]]. The trooper ran out of the shuttle and warned Pyre and [[Agent]] [[Tierny]], the latter of whom yelled to fall back. As the other stormtroopers fled, the individual briefly hesitated and looked to their left before running away. Despite their attempts to flee, all of the troopers were knocked down when the shuttle exploded. Soon after, the ''Thunderer'' was destroyed during the [[Battle of Barabesh]].<ref name="Escape" />

==Equipment==
The stormtrooper wore [[Color|white]] [[First Order stormtrooper armor]] and carried an F-11D [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="Escape" />

==Behind the scenes==
The stormtrooper appeared in part one of the two-part episode "[[The Escape (episode)|The Escape]],"<ref name="Escape" /> the finale of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 26]], [[2020]].<ref name="Disney Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> [[David Acord]] and [[Matthew Wood]] were credited as voicing stormtroopers in the episode.<ref name="Escape" />
